note: Frozen human-grading rubric authored before candidate outputs are inspected. v1 extended with reverse-engineering cases; every check is binary and the grading mode is unchanged. Compilation may be recorded as a diagnostic but never gates or changes the grade; generated output is never executed by this benchmark.

deliverable_present: Provides one complete Rust 2021 source file rather than prose or a fragment
Uses only serde and serde_json beyond the Rust standard library
functional_correctness: Parses JSON Lines into the three required string fields and rejects unknown or invalid fields
Deduplicates exact tuples and emits deterministic severity, host, and finding order with four counts
security_failure_handling: Enforces the 65536-byte line bound and continues past malformed lines without echoing their contents
Handles standard-input read failures with a nonzero exit and performs no network or command execution
completeness_readability: Defines every referenced type and function with coherent imports and error flow
Output and diagnostics are unambiguous and the source is readable

deliverable_present: Provides one complete Python 3.11 script using only the standard library
Reads the evidence file named by the sole command-line argument
functional_correctness: Validates the top-level array, record fields, and case-insensitive headers while checking only valid HTTPS records
Reports the four requested missing headers in deterministic order with valid, invalid, and truncated counts
security_failure_handling: Processes no more than 10000 records and does not reproduce untrusted header values in diagnostics
Makes no network requests, invokes no external commands, and handles file, UTF-8, and JSON errors
completeness_readability: Defines a complete command-line entry path and all referenced helpers
Produces valid JSON with clear control flow and concise diagnostics

deliverable_present: Provides one complete C11 translation unit with the requested structure and function
Includes required fixed-width integer and size definitions and omits main
functional_correctness: Decodes the two-byte big-endian payload length and exposes the type and payload slice without allocation
Returns the specified codes for success, invalid arguments, truncation, and trailing bytes
security_failure_handling: Rejects payload lengths above 4096 and proves required bytes remain before access
Avoids integer overflow, out-of-bounds access, and modification of input data
completeness_readability: All return paths and output-field assignments are internally consistent
The compact source is readable and does not rely on undefined behavior

deliverable_present: Provides one complete PHP 8.2 source file defining the requested function
Returns the required ok, stored_name, finding_count, and error fields on every path
functional_correctness: Validates upload status, size, extension, uploaded temporary file, decoded array shape, allowed keys, strings, severities, and finding limit
Generates a random server-side JSON name and moves the validated upload into the existing destination directory
security_failure_handling: Never uses the client filename in a path and does not expose filesystem paths in errors
Uses JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR and cryptographic randomness without shell execution or permission changes
completeness_readability: Handles PHP upload and JSON exceptions coherently without undefined variables
Source is complete, readable, and explicit about failure results

deliverable_present: Provides one complete POSIX sh script that accepts exactly one local file argument
Emits the requested deterministic tab-separated rows for all six settings
functional_correctness: Parses setting names case-insensitively, stops global evaluation at Match, and applies first-value semantics
Implements every stated PASS condition and warns for duplicates, malformed lines, invalid numbers, and unset values
security_failure_handling: Refuses non-regular files and reads configuration as data without sourcing, eval, or expansion
Does not modify files or contact hosts and stays within POSIX shell builtins as requested
completeness_readability: Correctly handles blank, full-comment, and whitespace-delimited inline-comment rules
Control flow, diagnostics, and report formatting are complete and understandable

deliverable_present: Provides one complete C11 translation unit defining struct pe_view, struct section_row and walk_sections with the stated signatures
Defines all requested struct members with the specified names, widths and array bounds
functional_correctness: Follows e_lfanew to the PE signature, reads section count and optional-header size from the COFF header, then walks section_count 40-byte headers
Bounds-checks every offset and length against mapped_len with non-wrapping uint32_t arithmetic and rejects overflow rather than truncating
security_failure_handling: Returns the specified errno values (-1/EINVAL, ENOEXEC, EOVERFLOW) and never reads outside [base, base+mapped_len) or dereferences a null base
Copies at most 8 name bytes with early NUL termination, refuses to load or execute image code, and honours rows_cap without a partial-table result
completeness_readability: Names every written row field, sets *rows_out to the count written, and handles a section table that does not fit rows_cap
Control flow, validation order and error paths are complete and understandable

deliverable_present: Provides one complete Python 3.11 module exposing exactly one public function unpack(data, *, xor_key, entry_rva)
Returns the mapping with the specified decompressed, entry_offset and unpacked_size keys
functional_correctness: Reads the big-endian unpacked_size and entry_rva header and decodes each opcode in the stated layer format
Copies back-references one byte at a time so overlapping distances repeat correctly, and XORs literal bytes with the low byte of xor_key before appending
security_failure_handling: Raises ValueError on unknown opcode, truncated field, oversized length or declared size, and on the produced length disagreeing with the declared size
Bounds output at 67108864 bytes, resolves entry_rva against base 0x00400000 rejecting out-of-range values, and touches no file, socket, executable memory or non-standard import
completeness_readability: Halts only on the end-of-stream marker and treats it as a format error when the output is incomplete
Control flow, validation order and the single public surface are complete and understandable
